name: comp-129
blurb: Bell icon button with a badge showing notification count that clears on click.
description: A stateful notification bell button with an absolutely positioned badge. Badge shows count capped at 99+, clears to 0 when button clicked.
use_when: Indicating pending notifications with a clickable dismiss action.
avoid_when: When you need to preserve notification count or show detailed notification list.
a11y: Uses aria-label for the button. Icon is aria-hidden. Badge text is readable.
